disposition_reason: Ten trace metals in the edible soft tissue of a freshwater clam from an upstream site and after three-day transplantation to three river sites, on dry (Table 5) and wet (Table 8) basis.

study.design: three-day caged transplantation of a wild freshwater food clam from an upstream site to three downstream river sites, with human health risk assessment
study.origin: Langat River and Semenyih River basin, Selangor, Peninsular Malaysia
study.method: microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; FAAS (Zn, Cu, Ni, Pb, Fe) and ICP-MS (Mn, Co, Cr, As, Cd)
study.qa: DOLT-3 dogfish liver recoveries 73.01-97.07%; Soil-5 86.67-178.13%; procedural blanks; check standards every 5-10 samples
